sentences.en: Where can I get hold of a good tax lawyer?
sentences.zh: 我在哪儿能找到一位好的税务律师？

sentences.en: The work will be a great tax on his time.
sentences.zh: 这项工作将会极大地占用他的时间。

sentences.en: We must look to the government for a tax cut.
sentences.zh: 我们必须指望政府减税。

senses.zh: 向……课税；使……负重担；缴纳车辆牌照税；批评；审定诉讼费
